title: How 3 Men Escaped Alcatraz With Spoons & Raincoats #Shorts
description:
On June 11, 1962, three inmates escaped Alcatraz with stolen spoons and 50 raincoats — and vanished forever.
Subscribe for daily US history & deep mysteries: https://www.youtube.com/@TheDeepChronicle

Frank Morris and brothers John and Clarence Anglin pulled off the most daring prison break in American history from Alcatraz Federal Penitentiary in San Francisco Bay. Using stolen cafeteria spoons, soap-and-hair decoy heads, and a makeshift raincoat raft, all three disappeared into the freezing bay — and no bodies were ever recovered.
